title: To War!
description:
Horses ahr powerful mounts.  At a full gallop, ya maahyt notaahce thuh shield-lookin' icon besaahd yo-wr hotbar.  Whe-yn this icon's full, ya'll blast through foes, damagin' whatever's unlucky enough ta be in front awf ya.  Armored eend war horses do eve-yn mo-wr damayge ta thuh po-wr soul.  But it's not jus' in front, what's behahnd ya kay-yun also git a daisy kickin' ifin' it attacks.
Thay're loyal friends, too.  Ya git hit whe-yn one's culohs an it'll come t' aid ya in an instant, fightin' until its bacon gets low.  But sumtaahms that's not such a daisy idea.  Ifin' ya evher need t' cahwl yo-wr pals awk, whistle eend thay're cut duhrt awk for a bit.  Once thay're safe, ya kay-yun whistle again.
Careful, though.  Yo-wr averayge ridden hoss may git spooked by thuh fightin' an drop ya.  Higher bond means thay're less likely ta, an war horses will nary.  Ya kay-yun count awn that
